title: Arizona 2012-01_L'impact le plus profond
text: with the enlightenment experience the the deepest trans transformational impact on the personality or what ken wilber calls the frontal self the deepest transformational impact comes from this when i'm describing to all of you and not from anything else not from doing shadow work not from doing psychotherapy as important as those things may be right the the deepest transformational impact on your frontal self and your personality right that you will that will become apparent to you and will become even more apparent to other people will be as a result of your capacity to let go of everything because if depending on your capacity to let go of everything something you will change you'll become a very different person your personality will become an expression of liberation itself a manifest expression of liberated consciousness and it's not it's not because you worked anything out it's because you let go of everything and once again it's not because you worked anything out it's because you let go of everything you can work things out and it can help you and it will help you but letting go of everything does something very different it liberates the self you
